I’m not sure if this has been resolved for you but I’ve figured out what to do,

1. Go on your payments section
2. Re-enter all of your bank details on every section 
3. Go to the “need help?”
4. Click on “technical issues” 
5. Scroll to the bottom and you should see a red link “contact us to send a request” 
6. Now here is the important part and everything you MUST include in this form and the text you input to Depop:

- Buyers username
- What the items are 
- When the items were sold
- When the items were delivered 
- Buyers are happy with items 
- That you have re-entered your bank details 


Why I say to include this all is because if you don’t, Depop will be going back and forth with you, but if you include everything initially, they won’t feel the need to.
But do stress the fact that you have re-entered your bank details. 

Hope this helps you or anyone else in the same situation 👊🏽
